verdicts.note: Self-describes as only woman in office and receives 'you're a woman' jokes; clearly female.
'didn't expect it to be as hard as it has been' directly maps to curriculum harder than expected -> agree.
'never gonna use this' plus expecting more useful content supports difficulty seeing module relevance -> agree.
Confidence with presentations supports interpersonal development, but quote tail is computer skills (technical); thin -> low.
Quote is about being happy with her education timing/route, not pleasure at studying engineering; she is a business student, construct is engineering-specific.
'good experiences and bad experiences' plus 'like it if good group' supports mixed/neutral satisfaction.
Friends/meeting people named as the best thing about course -> satisfied.
'this is silly'/'never gonna use this' is clearly negative about theory work -> dissatisfied.
Actively on a Network 75 work placement at the company -> yes.
Evidence quote is the interviewer's question 'What appealed to you about the Network 75 programme?' (interviewer-planted); also noplaoth is reasons for NOT going, but she did go.
'hard to get by when you're a student, nice to have a bit of money' supports money as a placement motive -> agree.
'best thing is the experience' explicitly values work experience -> agree.
'made me grow up a lot, learnt a lot from it' supports personal development -> agree.
'no ambition really of what I want to be' indicates undecided specialisation -> don't know.
Considering a law conversion course indicates interest in further study -> yes.
Law conversion course is not engineering/design related -> code 7.
'money would obviously come into it...why shouldn't I have the money' supports salary important.
Bought a house and wants to stay local near parents supports location important.
'nice atmosphere, good place to work' describes current job positively; importance in job choice is inferred, not stated -> low.
Wanting to stay because 'I like everybody there' supports people mattering, but importance-in-choice is inferred -> low.
